shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; echo ---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | head -80

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.js 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/i18n.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/index.d.ts; echo ---; grep -n "configure\|Lang\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/index.d.ts | head; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/ 2>/dev/null; echo ---; node -v; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i "vite\|tsc\|vitest"

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.js; echo ---; grep -n "Language\|Globe\|Flag" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo ---; grep -o '"[A-Za-z]*"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -0; grep -n "SegmentedRadioGroup\|Select\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -3; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -40

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -iE "^(jsdom|happy-dom|playwright|puppeteer)" ; npm ls jsdom happy-dom 2>/dev/null | tail -3) ; echo "=== App.tsx ==="; cat -n src/App.tsx | sed -n 1,30p
